annotations.text:
IDEA 1 — First minute has one job: take Kotaro somewhere.
No feed, no wallet, no tabs. One orange button. The locked chips hint at what the first post unlocks.

IDEA 2 — One bottom bar instead of six header buttons.
Feed · Snap (big orange shutter) · Ladder · Crew. The camera is always one tap away, which is the whole game. The green card is the next quest, pinned.

IDEA 3 — One light 'field' theme, camera included.
The live picture fills the screen (the hill here stands in for it); chrome is translucent white pills, not the current dark overlay. Locked props show the level that unlocks them.

IDEA 4 — Every unlock ends by naming the next quest.
Bing joins, then 'leave 1 comment to unlock Kotaro's sword'. The same quest is on the Feed card and the Ladder row, so a judge never wonders what to do.

IDEA 5 — Identity is a badge, not a guess.
Axie chips carry Cast (dark) or Owned (green); owners show a display name, guests show Guest-XXXX. The podium ranks people by quest level, as the server already does.

IDEA 6 — 'Crew' replaces 'Profile' and Idol Points.
What you own is the cast that follows you: a grid with level tags on locked faces, props as chips, your moments below. Connect Ronin is a card, not a gate.
